scope: Two primary papers; no changes to the running 40-coefficient experiment.

papers.title: The Pitfalls of Next-Token Prediction
papers.paper_method_and_result: On path-star graph tasks, later gold-prefix tokens permit a local adjacency shortcut while the first required node remains poorly predicted on held-out graphs. They test the shortcut by supplying a random first node and observing continuation; teacherless lookahead targets help in some settings, and reversing path order improves learning.
papers.relevance_inference: Motivates measuring an early context-dependent choice separately from accuracy on later gold-prefix tokens. Our observed failure occurs on exact training prompts.

papers.title: Critical Tokens Matter: Token-Level Contrastive Estimation Enhances LLM’s Reasoning Capability
papers.paper_method_and_result: They identify influential failure tokens using continuation rollouts and test forcing alternatives. For scalable annotations, separately fine-tuned positive and negative models provide token-level contrastive scores. cDPO weights only the rejected trajectory’s reward terms by one minus those scores. LoRA math experiments report gains over their baselines on GSM8K and MATH500.
papers.relevance_inference: Motivates measuring how forced alternative prefixes change downstream generated answers.

priority_proposal.origin: Our diagnostic informed by the two papers; performed after model selection.
priority_proposal.name: Forced structural-prefix continuation control
priority_proposal.budget: Four fixed concern prompts for each of the previous equal-answer epoch12 and new selected verdict checkpoint; 192 generated tokens each, temperature0.
priority_proposal.intervention: Keep each original system/user prompt and model checkpoint. Supply only the correct assistant structural prefix {"findings":[{" and generate the remainder without supplying line_id or reason. Compare to the already-recorded ordinary generation on those exact prompts.
priority_proposal.compatibility: Uses the existing native inference path and the same final-MLP adapter. No new tensors, trainer math, tokenizer vocabulary or runtime behavior is required.
measure: specific correct consequence from supplied context
fabricated rules or copied cross-case reason
priority_proposal.interpretation: Score conditioned line and reason generation. Natural generation remains the measurement of autonomous concern detection.
priority_proposal.tokenization_note: Use the complete structural prefix, not token 788 as a forced clean verdict: 788 emits only quote-colon; 66582 emits quote-colon-open-array-open-object-quote.

run_status: Proposals only. No new training, inference generations, source edits or corpus changes performed for this research.
